services.title: IPF Stock Recovery Assistance
services.summary: End-to-end procedural guidance for reclaiming equity shares and accrued dividends transferred to the IEPF Authority.
services.description: Under Section 124(6) of the Companies Act, shares where dividends remain unclaimed for 7 consecutive years are transferred to the IEPF Authority. We assist clients in navigating the statutory verification protocol, e-Form IEPF-5 submission, and RTA verification reports.
whoIsItFor: Shareholders who missed dividend warrants for 7+ years
Holders whose shares no longer appear in their Demat holding statement
Senior citizens with legacy physical share certificates
steps: Folio and unclaimed dividend verification against company registers
Preparation of statutory e-Form IEPF-5 on MCA V3 Portal
Compilation of indemnity bond, affidavit, and advance receipt
Submission of physical docket to company Nodal Officer and RTA
keyDocuments: Copy of Client Master List (CML) of active Demat account
Original cancelled cheque leaf with printed name

services.title: Recovery Process Guidance
services.summary: Structured advisory on corporate restructuring, stock splits, demergers, and bonus share reconciliation.
services.description: Over decades, companies undergo demergers, splits, and amalgamations (e.g. Reliance, L&T, HDFC). We clarify your accrued entitlement so you understand the exact number of shares and cumulative dividends eligible for claim.
whoIsItFor: Investors unaware of multiple corporate restructurings over decades
Holders of historical share certificates with altered ISINs
steps: Historical corporate action mapping (bonus, split, demerger ratios)
Dividend register audit spanning past 7 to 15 financial years
Reconciliation with Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA) records

Cases with minor spelling variations between PAN, Aadhaar, and share certificates

services.title: Documentation Assistance

faqs.question: What is IPF stock recovery?
faqs.answer: IPF (commonly referred to in Indian corporate law as IEPF – Investor Education and Protection Fund) stock recovery refers to the legal, procedural process of reclaiming shares and unpaid dividends transferred by publicly listed companies to the government under Section 124(6) of the Companies Act, 2013 after remaining unclaimed for 7 consecutive years. Recovery involves filing statutory forms, verifying KYC with the company RTA, and securing approval from the IEPF Authority.

faqs.question: How can I enquire about a recovery case with your team?
faqs.answer: You can submit an inquiry through our verified online form, message our advisory desk on WhatsApp at +91 98200 11223, or call during business hours. Please mention the name of the company/shares, approximate quantity, and whether you possess physical certificates or folio numbers.

faqs.question: What documents may be required for the claim process?
faqs.answer: Standard documentation includes: (1) Client Master List (CML) of your active Demat account, (2) Original physical share certificates or indemnity for duplicate issuance, (3) Self-attested PAN and Aadhaar, (4) Cancelled cheque leaf matching bank details, (5) Form ISR-1 and ISR-2 (bank signature attestation), and (6) for deceased shareholders, notarized death certificate and legal heir documentation.

faqs.question: How can I contact the company directly?
faqs.answer: You can contact Veritas Advisory via official WhatsApp (+91 98200 11223), phone call (+91 98200 11223), email (advisory@veritasrecovery.in), or visit our corporate office at Level 7, Fortune Towers, BKC, Mumbai during business hours.

faqs.question: How can I check the status of my inquiry?
faqs.answer: Upon submitting your inquiry, you receive a unique Inquiry Tracking ID (e.g. IPF-2026-0001-XXXX). You can quote this ID anytime to our coordinators via WhatsApp or phone for immediate status updates.

faqs.question: Do you ask for my trading passwords, OTPs, or bank credentials?
faqs.answer: NEVER. Veritas Advisory will NEVER ask for your Demat account passwords, trading login credentials, OTPs, or net banking passwords. We only assist with legitimate paper filings, MCA portal documentation, and RTA submissions.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee 100% recovery or fixed completion timelines?
faqs.answer: No. As a transparent and ethical corporate consultancy, we strictly adhere to legal guidelines. Statutory approvals rest entirely with company Nodal Officers, RTAs, and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (IEPF Authority). We ensure flawless documentation, procedural compliance, and persistent follow-up, but no legitimate entity can guarantee government approval times or outcomes.
